'''ovl_Boss_Va''' is the [[Barinade]] boss actor
{{clear}}

== Fight Notes ==
===Phase 1=== 
3 Tentacles attached to Jabu Jabu
5 Bari connected by electrified tether, move slowly
If the tethers disappear without Barinade being stunned (happens over time), the "radar" dish protects Barinade. 
When core is stunned, each hit kills one of the Bari
When all Bari are defeated, end of phase 1

=== Phase 2===
5 more Biri connected by electrified tether, spin fast
over time, radar dish will attack twice? if player hasn't stunned Barinade
When all Bari are defeated, end of phase 2

===Phase 3===
No Bari protecting Barinade
Barinade has starting health of 4. After depleted, resets to 3 or less if overkill and Barinade becomes invincible. After this second health count is depleted, resets to 3 or less if overkill. If health drops below zero, Barinade is killed
